Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)

Optimize Every Marketing Dollar

AI-powered marketing mix modeling that quantifies the impact of every marketing channel, optimizes budget allocation, and maximizes ROI. Transform your marketing into a predictable, high‑performance growth engine.

The Challenge

Marketing Spend is Fragmented and Unpredictable

50%

Of marketing budgets are wasted on underperforming channels — but most companies can't identify which ones without robust attribution modeling.

40%

Of marketers lack the analytics to measure the true ROI of their campaigns, relying on last‑click attribution that overvalues digital and undervalues brand channels.

$200B+

Estimated annual waste in global marketing spend due to suboptimal allocation and lack of accurate attribution.

Quantify. Optimize. Dominate.

Marketing spend is one of the largest investments a company makes — yet it's often one of the least understood. Without accurate attribution, you can't know which channels are driving revenue, which are wasting money, or how to allocate your budget for maximum impact.

Our Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) service uses advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to quantify the impact of every marketing channel — TV, digital, social, print, radio, events, and more — on your sales and revenue.

We attribute incremental revenue to each channel, accounting for interactions, synergies, and diminishing returns. We identify which channels are driving the highest ROI and recommend optimal budget allocations to maximize revenue and profitability.

With our solution, you transform marketing from a cost center into a predictable, high‑performance growth engine. You allocate every dollar where it has the greatest impact, achieving superior ROI and sustainable growth.

Marketing Mix Modeling

How We Build Your Marketing Mix Model

Data Integration & Harmonization

We aggregate data from all your marketing channels — TV, digital, social, print, radio, and events — along with internal sales data and external factors like seasonality and economic indicators. We harmonize these disparate data sources into a unified analytics platform, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

Model Development & Attribution

We build sophisticated statistical and machine learning models — including regression, time-series, and Bayesian methods — to quantify the impact of each marketing channel on sales and revenue. We attribute incremental revenue to each channel, accounting for interactions and diminishing returns.

Channel Performance & ROI Analysis

We assess the effectiveness and ROI of each marketing channel and campaign. We identify which channels are driving the most revenue, which are underperforming, and where you're getting the best return on your marketing spend.

Budget Optimization & Allocation

We use optimization algorithms to recommend the optimal allocation of your marketing budget across channels. We maximize revenue and ROI while respecting budget constraints, ensuring every dollar is spent where it has the greatest impact.

Scenario Planning & What‑If Analysis

We enable you to simulate different budget allocation scenarios and assess their impact on revenue and ROI. You can test the effect of increasing spend on one channel, decreasing on another, or introducing new channels — before committing real budget.

Continuous Monitoring & Optimization

We provide real‑time dashboards that track marketing performance, channel ROI, and budget utilization. We continuously refine models as new data emerges, ensuring your marketing strategy remains optimized and responsive to changing conditions.
